source_tweet.text:
We had a very special guest visit SHIFT UP! @Theweeknd dropped in to meet @jamm3rd, check out the studio, and see what we've been working on!

It was such a huge honor to meet Abel and hear he was a fan of Stellar Blade. We hope you enjoy the rest of your time in Korea!
